item.title: Claude Code Voice Control on Windows: Dictate Prompts and Hear Replies Aloud
item.description: Voice control for Claude Code and T3 Code on Windows: local speech-to-text for your prompts, and every reply read aloud by voiceloop, even from a server.

item.title: Local AI on Proxmox: The Complete Homelab Guide (2026)
item.description: How to run local LLMs, voice and image generation on a Proxmox homelab: GPU choice, LXC vs VM, Ollama, Open WebUI, Tailscale access, agents and backups.

item.title: Claude Code with a Local Ollama Model: Setup, and What a 12 GB GPU Can Do
item.description: Run Claude Code against a local Ollama model with three environment variables. I timed gemma4 and qwen3.5 on two small coding tasks on an RTX 3060.

item.title: Home Assistant Conversation Agent with a Local Ollama Model: Which Model Works
item.description: Point Home Assistant's Assist at a local Ollama model. I tested gemma4 and qwen3.5 on an RTX 3060 with 18 commands each. One passed all 18, one passed 6.

item.title: Home Assistant Local Voice Assistant with Whisper and Piper in Docker
item.description: Build a Home Assistant voice assistant that never leaves your LAN: Whisper, Piper and Assist in one Docker Compose file, with measured speeds and two gotchas.

item.title: How I Turned My Laptop Into a Dumb Terminal With a Tailscale Dev VM, T3 Code, and Claude Code
item.description: A persistent dev VM over Tailscale running T3 Code and Claude Code turns any laptop into a thin client, and why I'm stripping Windows down instead of upgrading.

item.title: Running Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU Passthrough
item.description: Set up Ollama in a Proxmox LXC with NVIDIA GPU passthrough, Tailscale access and Open WebUI. Run local LLMs with GPU acceleration on your own hardware.

item.title: Running Uptime Kuma With Docker Compose
item.description: Deploy Uptime Kuma website and API monitoring with Docker Compose. Self-hosted uptime tracker and status page for infrastructure monitoring in a home lab.
